notes: Curated eval focused on sequencing, near-miss boundary checks, and context insertion. Apply full-deliverable checks only when that deliverable was requested. Definitions are not executed results.

should_trigger.prompt: I need a quarter plan for new-product launch enablement, but we also need seller talk tracks and a way to measure whether the rollout worked. Which skills should I run and in what order?
This request mixes onboarding redesign, certification refresh, and manager coaching. Route it to the smallest useful sequence and tell me the handoffs between each step.
We have no current enablement context, and I want objection mining from Gong plus updated battlecards for enterprise reps. Give me the right staged workflow.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Create stage-specific talk tracks for enterprise AEs handling security and procurement pressure.
Design a manager coaching cadence for a six-manager mid-market team with weekly call review and deal inspection loops.
Summarize this quarter's enablement metrics and turn them into a leadership impact narrative.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-router-output-01
output_structure_checks.description: Defaults to the specialist for a direct ask. A sequence adds only separately requested work or a necessary dependency, with each skill's availability clear.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-router-output-02
output_structure_checks.description: Explains the chosen skill's job and closest boundary only as needed to prevent a routing error.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-router-output-03
output_structure_checks.description: Names missing inputs that would change the route or next deliverable.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-router-output-04
output_structure_checks.description: Names the usable output or handoff from each recommended step.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-router-output-05
output_structure_checks.description: Identifies process, incentive, product, or capacity problems that enablement cannot solve, while preserving useful work within scope.

output_structure_checks.name: enablement-router-practitioner-fit
output_structure_checks.description: Does not force context setup before a self-contained request or assume unavailable sibling skills were loaded.
